title: system.describe data
description: The system an engine built for a case, re-read from the engine's own model: S surfaces, L lines and K sag radii per surface. Lengths in mm, in the contract frame. Code checks that the shapes agree with one another.

stopSemiDiameter.description: The stop's radius, from which the engine derives the pupils.

vertexZ.description: The vertex position of each surface; shape [S].

curvature.description: The base curvature of each surface, 1/radius; 0 for a plane and for a flat base; shape [S].

conic.description: The conic constant of each surface; 0 for a plane; shape [S].

clipRadius.description: The largest radial height at which the engine lets a ray pass each surface; on the stop surface, the one of the case's stop setting; shape [S].

innerClipRadius.description: The radial height below which the engine stops a ray at each surface: the radius of a central obstruction; 0 for a surface without one; shape [S].

indexAfterSurface.description: The refractive index of the medium that follows each surface, per line; shape [L, S].

sagRadii.description: The radial heights the sag is given at: each fraction times the surface's nominal semi-diameter; shape [S, K].

sag.description: The sag of each surface at each of its radii, as the engine evaluates it; NaN where the surface has no real sag; shape [S, K].

terms.description: Per surface, the polynomial terms the engine holds whose coefficient is not zero, by ascending power; S lists.
